requirement.statement: CRUD SHALL support inline fixed nodes and dictionaries loaded by provider identifier. Every provider load MUST receive the complete dictionary id, scope, normalized context parameters, load mode, query term or value set, refresh flag and request correlation id; a provider MUST return an array of standard dictionary nodes.

case.given: 一个字段绑定内联固定节点
case.when: 该字段首次需要展示选项
case.then: 系统 SHALL 在不执行 provider I/O 的情况下投影这些节点

case.given: 一个字段绑定依赖上级字段的 provider 字典
case.then: 系统 SHALL 以新的作用域上下文产生加载意图，且 provider SHALL 能区分旧上下文和新上下文

requirement.statement: CRUD SHALL construct a cache key from dictionary definition, scope, mode, query term and context parameters. refresh MUST bypass applicable cache and generate a new request correlation id; invalidate MUST invalidate matching cache and in-flight results. The reducer MUST accept only results still correlated to current state.

case.given: 同一作用域的普通加载已有未过期缓存
case.then: 系统 MAY 使用缓存，且 view model SHALL 与缓存节点一致

case.given: 同一作用域已有未过期缓存
case.then: 系统 MUST 调用 provider，而不是将缓存命中当作刷新完成

case.given: 旧上下文加载尚未返回，随后产生了新上下文加载
case.then: 系统 MUST 忽略旧 result，当前可见节点不得被覆盖

requirement.statement: CRUD SHALL support loading nodes for selected values that are absent from current visible nodes. Hydrated nodes MUST join the known-value index for label resolution, but unless they match the active query they MUST NOT automatically join the visible option list.

case.given: 表单初始值包含当前可见节点中不存在的值
case.when: 控件需要显示该值的 label
case.then: 系统 SHALL 发起按值补全，并在成功后投影该 label

requirement.statement: A search-capable control SHALL translate a search term to a dictionary search command. Control open, dependent-field changes and selected-value changes SHALL only issue CRUD commands. The UI adapter MUST NOT call network APIs, construct URLs or own dictionary cache.

case.given: 一个启用了远程检索的选择控件
case.then: 系统 SHALL 将该词作为加载意图的查询字段交给 provider，并从 view model 投影 loading 与结果

case.when: 对应 failed result 被归约
case.then: 控件 SHALL 从 view model 获得可显示的失败状态，且既有成功数据不得被错误清空

requirement.statement: CRUD SHALL continue projecting `data` as current visible nodes and `dataMap` as the known-value index. CRUD reducers, view models and UI adapters MUST NOT import a concrete HTTP client or execute side effects.

case.given: 应用使用仅含固定节点或简单 URL 的既有字典配置
case.then: 该应用 SHALL 保持可用，并可逐步迁移到显式 provider 定义
